Markets.title: Behari Lal Engineering shares set to debut today; GMP signals 47% premium ahead of listing
Markets.summary: Behari Lal Engineering shares are set to debut on the stock market today following an initial public offering that was subscribed 108.44 times overall between August 12 and August 14. Ahead of the listing, the grey market premium (GMP) indicates an estimated 47% gain for investors.

Markets.title: Shiprocket shares to list today; GMP signals 37% listing gains
Markets.summary: Shiprocket shares are set to list today following a Rs 1,617.48-crore IPO that was subscribed 99.38 times between August 12 and August 14. The grey market premium (GMP) indicates expected listing gains of 37%.

Markets.title: Dividend alert! Mazagon Dock, Natco Pharma among 15 stocks turning ex-dividend on Thursday. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders has set August 20 as the record date for its final dividend of Rs 4.62 per share for the 2026 financial year. The company is one of 15 stocks going ex-dividend on Thursday.

Markets.title: Gaja Alternative Asset Management IPO opens today: GMP at 19% — Should You Subscribe?
Markets.summary: The three-day Gaja Alternative Asset Management IPO opens today, August 19, and closes on August 21, 2026. The company is offering shares in a price band of Rs 152 to Rs 160 apiece, with a current grey market premium of 19%.

Markets.title: Negative Breakout: These 13 stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
Markets.summary: Thirteen stocks have crossed below their 200-day moving averages in a negative breakout. Traders watch this key technical indicator to determine the overall trend of a stock.

Markets.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: GIFT Nifty signals a muted start; Asian shares trade lower
Markets.summary: Indian stock market indices are expected to open on a flat to muted note, according to GIFT Nifty indicators. Meanwhile, Asian stock markets are trading lower in early session activity.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister is advocating for a presidential election. Elections in the country have been suspended since martial law was enacted in February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Trump pauses new tariffs on Canada and says countries close to a deal
Geo-Political.summary: US President Donald Trump delayed new tariffs on Canadian goods for three days. The temporary pause gives both countries time to finalize an ongoing trade agreement.

Geo-Political.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
Geo-Political.summary: US states have begun a major trial alleging that Meta intentionally addicted children to Facebook and Instagram. Meta denied these claims in court, arguing that social media addiction does not exist.

Geo-Political.title: Witness gets combative in Tupac murder trial - 'I don't want to send him to prison'
Geo-Political.summary: A witness in the murder trial of rapper Tupac Shakur became combative while testifying against Duane "Keffe D" Davis. Although the witness expressed dislike for Davis, he refused to answer questions that could send him to prison.

Geo-Political.title: Brazil's President Lula hails oil discovery near Amazon river
Geo-Political.summary: Brazilian President Lula has praised a new oil discovery in the sea near the mouth of the Amazon River. Environmentalists have strongly criticized the exploratory drilling that led to the find.

Geo-Political.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies aged 77
Geo-Political.summary: Frank Beard, the drummer for the blues-rock band ZZ Top, has died at the age of 77. A statement on the band's website announced that he passed away on Monday while in hospice care.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author tested ChatGPT to see if their WordPress SaaS course would be recommended without paid advertising. The AI recommended their course as the top result, demonstrating a new way to gain organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires creators to use artificial intelligence to stay ahead. A new guide highlights the top 10 AI tools that are revolutionizing and simplifying content creation.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is a generative AI platform that allows users to create various types of AI-generated content. Additionally, the platform provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia war, high inflation, currency depreciation, and weak capital expenditure pose downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has accelerated agricultural spending and fertilizer outlays to protect rural incomes. This financial intervention aims to counter the economic risks posed by El Nino and a weak monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research projects a $50 billion surplus in India's balance of payments for the 2027 fiscal year. This financial milestone is expected to be driven by strong foreign currency inflows.

Data & Insights.title: Patchy progress, masked extremes: how the Southwest Monsoon has played out so far
Data & Insights.summary: Although the overall Southwest Monsoon rainfall deficit has decreased to 13%, the season has been marked by severe regional imbalances. These imbalances are caused by erratic swings between intense downpours and extended dry spells.

Data & Insights.title: Govt weighs scrapping performance bank guarantees for MSME contracts
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is considering the removal of performance bank guarantee requirements for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) receiving government contracts. This potential policy shift is significant because MSMEs accounted for half of the central government's ₹2.30 trillion procurement in fiscal year 2026.

Data & Insights.title: India’s overall unemployment rate falls in July; joblessness rises in urban centres but eases in rural areas
Data & Insights.summary: India's overall unemployment rate decreased in July, according to data from the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS). While joblessness increased in urban areas, it decreased in rural regions.

India.title: 9 Bangladeshi Nationals Killed In Kolkata Hotel Fire, AC Blast Suspected
India.summary: A fire at a Kolkata hotel killed nine Bangladeshi nationals. Initial reports suggest an air-conditioner explosion may have caused the blaze, though the exact cause remains unconfirmed.

India.title: NTA Removes 600 Experts, Introduces Four-Tier Question Paper Checking System
India.summary: The National Testing Agency removed 600 experts following recent controversies. It also introduced a four-tier question paper checking system to reduce errors and strengthen scrutiny.

India.title: "Our Action Was Correct": Tukaram Munde On Rs 5 Lakh Fine On Pune Sweet Shop
India.summary: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration Commissioner Tukaram Munde defended a food safety action after the Bombay High Court ordered compensation for a Pune sweet shop. Munde stated that the penalty and subsequent action against the shop were correct.

India.title: Jharkhand Government Releases list Of 44 Recruitment Exams Cancelled Due To Irregularities
India.summary: The Jharkhand government has cancelled 44 recruitment exams held since 2014 due to alleged irregularities. This decision follows ongoing protests by students demanding fairness in the state's hiring processes.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Students Made To Drink Urine, Principal Says 'Eat Chocolate To Feel Better'
India.summary: A student in Madhya Pradesh mixed urine into a water bottle and tricked classmates into drinking it. The school principal responded to the incident by telling the victims to eat chocolate to feel better.

India.title: Bidesh Sikhya Bruti 2026: Odisha Launches Overseas Scholarship For SC, ST Students
India.summary: Odisha has launched the Bidesh Sikhya Bruti scholarship to help Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students pursue postgraduate and PhD studies abroad. The program aims to provide financial support for international higher education opportunities.

General.title: Three dead after family get into difficulty in sea
General.summary: Three people died and a young girl was left in critical condition after getting into difficulty while swimming off the Sussex coast. The victims include a man, a woman, and a teenage girl.

General.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
General.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister has called for the country to hold a presidential election. Elections are currently suspended because martial law has been in effect since February 2022.

General.title: 'Everyone in for Christmas' - Burnham unveils rough sleeping plan
General.summary: Rough sleepers in England will be offered housing, in a move likened to the “Everyone In” initiative during the pandemic...

General.title: Scientists stunned by children's lung recovery in ultra low emission zone
General.summary: A scientific study shows that children's lung capacity caught up with peers in less polluted areas after a clean air zone was introduced. Researchers were stunned by the speed of this recovery in the ultra-low emission zone.

General.title: Camilla admits it was 'difficult' to keep King's cancer diagnosis a secret
General.summary: Queen Camilla has spoken publicly for the first time about King Charles's cancer diagnosis. In a video for Maggie's cancer charity, she admitted that keeping the diagnosis a secret was difficult.

General.title: Meta hooked children on Facebook and Instagram, US court hears
General.summary: A US trial has begun regarding a major lawsuit brought by multiple states accusing Meta of intentionally hooking children on Facebook and Instagram. In response, Meta argued that social media addiction does not exist.
